floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

copy.what: real reference cells at the count rule

b0.what: B0 (feat-009): T1 chamber-only copy plus damped momentum; T2 copy plus damped momentum or bracket interpolation, both in count space

b0_trend.what: B0 with each lineage's per-gene velocity the least-squares trend of log(mean CP10k + eps) over every input stage where it has min_cells cells, read over B0's time budget (heart only; count space)

b0_trend_flow.what: b0_trend with D from H10's field (vec.latent_extrap.fold_flow and flow_latent): r the decoder's mean ratio at z + du over z, du the move centred within the lineage's drawn cells, D = r over G, G set so that the lineage's expected pseudobulk after b0_trend's depth rule is unchanged (vec.trend_flow.recentre_after_depth; heart only)

b0_trend_flow_perm.what: b0_trend_flow's placebo: the field fitted with each lineage's stage means kept and the within-lineage residuals permuted across stages (vec.trend_flow.permute_residuals)

b0_trend_flow_pool.what: b0_trend_flow with the field fitted on latents centred on their lineage's mean at their stage, over every transition, the drawn cells' centred latents integrated

b0_trend_flow_pool_perm.what: b0_trend_flow_pool's placebo: the residuals centred on their true (lineage, stage) means, then permuted across stages within lineage before the pairs
